claims.name: ArtinG.evalWord_append
claims.statement: Evaluating concatenated atom lists equals the ordered product of their evaluations.
assumptions: An arbitrary monoid M, generator evaluation a, and honest List words.
claims.printed_statement:
theorem ArtinG.evalWord_append.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {S : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Monoid M] (a : S → M)
  (u v : List S), ArtinG.evalWord a (u ++ v) = ArtinG.evalWord a u * ArtinG.evalWord a v
claims.mathematical_novelty_vs_formalization: Formalization of the baseline or standard argument; no mathematical priority claim.

claims.name: ArtinG.evalWord_degree

assumptions: An arbitrary monoid M, generator evaluation a, and honest List words.
degree(1)=0; degree(u*v)=degree(u)+degree(v); every atom has degree 1.

  degree 1 = 0 →
    (∀ (u v : M), degree (u * v) = degree u + degree v) →

theorem ArtinG.ComplementTable.telescoping.{u_1, u_2, u_3} : ∀ {S : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2}

theorem ArtinG.ComplementTable.accepted_output_equality.{u_1, u_2, u_3} : ∀ {S : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2}

claims.name: ArtinG.join_complement_balance
claims.statement: For the actual complement formula u^-1*join(u,v), positive-lift complement balance follows from additive lift multiplication and the prefix length law.

claims.printed_statement:
theorem ArtinG.join_complement_balance.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {W : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : Group W] [inst_1 : Monoid M]
  (join : W → W → W) (rank : W → ℕ) (lift : W → M),
  (∀ (u v : W), join u v = join v u) →
    (∀ (u v : W), rank (join u v) = rank u + rank (ArtinG.coxeterComplement join u v)) →
      (∀ (u v : W), rank (u * v) = rank u + rank v → lift (u * v) = lift u * lift v) →
        ∀ (u v : W),
          lift u * lift (ArtinG.coxeterComplement join u v) = lift v * lift (ArtinG.coxeterComplement join v u)

claims.name: ArtinG.join_accepted_output_equality

rank(join(u,v))=rank(u)+rank(u^-1*join(u,v)).
M is a monoid; lift(u*v)=lift(u)*lift(v) whenever Coxeter ranks add.

theorem ArtinG.join_accepted_output_equality.{u_1, u_2, u_3} : ∀ {S : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3}
  [inst : Group W] [inst_1 : Monoid M] (simple : S → W) (join : W → W → W) (rho : W → List S) (rank : W → ℕ)
  (lift : W → M) (a : S → M),
  (∀ (w : W), ArtinG.evalWord a (rho w) = lift w) →
    (∀ (s : S), lift (simple s) = a s) →

        (∀ (u v : W), join u v = join v u) →
          (∀ (u v : W), rank (join u v) = rank u + rank (ArtinG.coxeterComplement join u v)) →

                (ArtinG.tableOfJoin simple join rho).residual (ArtinG.coxeterComplement join (simple x) q) v = 1 →
                  ArtinG.evalWord a (x :: v) =
                    lift q *
                      ArtinG.evalWord a
                        (rho (ArtinG.coxeterComplement join q (simple x)) ++
                          (ArtinG.tableOfJoin simple join rho).output (ArtinG.coxeterComplement join (simple x) q) v)

claims.statement: Positive grading and zero-rank state detection imply that a simple value divides 1 exactly in the identity state.
assumptions: M is a monoid; value(identity)=1.
